project_info.theme: Striped polo display with premium interior styling
project_info.color_palette: Black, white, gray, dark walnut, pale gray

main_subject.detail: Two striped short-sleeve polos hang on wooden hangers from a metal rail inside a styled premium interior scene. Large typography reads 'STRIPED POLO' while decor books, a framed art print, and dark slatted wall textures create a lifestyle merchandising backdrop.
main_subject.style: Photorealistic interior merchandising, premium menswear display, modern home-luxury styling

items: Upper Middle: large headline 'STRIPED' in white and 'POLO' in black below it.
Right: two striped polos on wooden hangers hanging from a curved silver rail, one black-white striped and one gray-white striped.
Left: framed minimal art print standing on a dark cabinet.
Lower Left Center: stacked decor books including 'monochrome home' and 'HERMES'.
Background: split between dark vertical slat wall and smooth pale gray panel.
Bottom Left: small white product code 'POKTK740'.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Refined contrast, premium showroom ambiance, crisp textile definition, calm upscale interior mood

assets.name: two striped polos on hangers
assets.usage: Use to preserve the stripe orientation, collar contrast, hanger spacing, and front-facing garment drape.

assets.name: styled premium interior backdrop
assets.usage: Maintain the framed artwork, stacked books, dark cabinet, and split slat/panel wall composition.

assets.name: STRIPED POLO typography
assets.usage: Preserve the exact wording, upper placement, and white/black hierarchy of the title.

prompt_instructions: Attach the original image so the interior decor balance and polo arrangement stay accurate.
Keep all visible text exactly as 'BADASS', 'STRIPED POLO', and 'POKTK740'.
Do not simplify away the decor books and framed art; they are part of the merchandising look.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square merchandising poster for a striped polo collection. Create a premium interior scene with a dark cabinet, a framed minimal art print on the left, stacked decor books, and a background split between a dark vertical slat wall and a pale gray panel. On the right, hang two striped short-sleeve polos from wooden hangers on a curved silver rail: one black-white striped with black collar and one gray-white striped with white collar. Add a white BADASS wordmark in the upper-right corner and large title text 'STRIPED POLO' above the garments. Include small white product code text 'POKTK740' at the lower left. Technical style: photorealistic interior merchandising poster, soft directional interior light, crisp textile definition, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, low resolution, distorted garments, wrong stripe pattern, missing decor props, incorrect text, flat 2d, cluttered staging, watermark, signature
